description: prBodyNotes: pin the message release-please parses to just the PR title. Renovate bodies embed upstream release notes, and release-please's parser throws on some free-form lines (googleapis/release-please#2564), silently dropping the whole fix(deps) commit from the changelog (#1208). release-please reads BEGIN_COMMIT_OVERRIDE from the merged PR body, so the release notes stay visible for review.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major npm updates into a single PR (shares package-lock.json + npmDepsHash, so separate PRs conflict).
Group all non-major Go module updates into a single PR (shares go.sum + vendorHash, so separate PRs conflict).
